structured.answer: If my 30k just sits in the עו"ש it loses value every year. The page's example is 10,000 ₪ that's worth about 8,203 ₪ after 10 years, and if I scale that up in my head my 30k ends up around 24-25k. So I'm moving it out, probably to a קרן כספית to start, but I'm not sure exactly how much I'd lose because the page shows two different 'loss' numbers.

stuck.where: Screens 2-4, the 'כמה עולה להשאיר כסף בעו"ש?' calculator
stuck.why: The sentence says I'd have 1,797 ₪ less, but the chart and the big number under it say 'המחיר של להשאיר 2,576 ₪'. Two different losses for the same 10,000. I guessed the bigger one is compared to the קרן כספית line, but that's a guess.
It's clearly where my own amount goes, but it was set to 10,000 and I couldn't get 30,000 in from here, so I just multiplied by three in my head.
Out of nowhere there's a huge 62,681 ₪. For a second I thought it was a gain, then I saw 'ההפקדות שלכם 70,000 ₪'. So it's actually a loss, with 500 a month added. That threw me.
